title: Okviri napada i proces odgovora na incidente
title_en: Attack frameworks and the incident response process
summary: Cyber Kill Chain, Diamond Model i MITRE ATT&CK za opis i prekid napada, OSSTMM/OWASP kao okviri testiranja, te IR proces od pripreme do post-incident faze i NIST SP 800-61r3 mapiranje na CSF 2.0.
summary_en: Cyber Kill Chain, Diamond Model, and MITRE ATT&CK for describing and disrupting attacks, OSSTMM/OWASP as testing frameworks, and the IR process from preparation to the post-incident phase, plus how NIST SP 800-61r3 maps to CSF 2.0.
